author: me me
reply: Thank you. Weekly is how it runs while there's activity - the moles never get a chance to settle back in between visits. Glad it was easy on your end.

author: Donald Ward
reply: Donald, thank you. It's your property, so how it gets handled is your call - we'd rather ask up front than assume. Glad the crew made the catches, and I appreciate the recommendation.

author: Carey Jenkins
reply: Carey, love it. One mole can tear up a surprising amount of lawn on its own, so getting that one is the whole job. Glad it's stayed quiet - call us if anything new pops up.

author: patty Ring
reply: Patty, keeping pets safe is a big part of how we work, so the heads-up before each visit matters. Thanks for letting us know it helped, and give the dog a pat for us.

author: Tanner Aden
reply: Thanks for the 5 stars, Tanner. Appreciate you taking the time.

author: Ron Davis
reply: Ron, low touch on your end is exactly how it should work - you shouldn't have to manage your mole guy. Alias will be glad to hear this, and I'll make sure he sees it. Thank you.

author: Mike Dosch
reply: Mike, thanks for coming back to us each time. When they keep showing up it's usually new ones moving in from the ground around you, not the old ones surviving. If you ever get tired of spotting the mounds first, the year-round program is built for exactly that.

author: Richard Kaumans
reply: Richard, two years in a row usually means good soil with open ground nearby - new moles move in each season looking for it. Glad we got it handled both times. Thank you.

author: Craig Nelson
reply: Craig, thank you. Luke takes being on time seriously, and he'll be glad to hear the catch landed. I'll make sure he sees this.

author: Rick Broderick
reply: Rick, a referral from someone who's already been through it is the best way we get new customers. Glad we lived up to what your friend told you - thanks to you both.

author: Terry Tuttle
reply: Terry, a big event with a torn-up front lawn is about the worst timing there is. Good talking with you on the phone, and I'm glad we got it turned around fast and the five weeks went smoothly. Hope the event went well - thank you.

author: Kim Suver
reply: Kim, reporting new activity when you see it is a big help - the sooner we're on fresh mounds, the less lawn they tear up. Thanks for keeping us posted, and for the recommendation.

author: Gates
reply: Thank you, Gates. Store-bought products add up fast once you count the repeat purchases and the lawn repair. Glad we could just get it done for you.

author: Sharon Young
reply: Sharon, thank you. Arriving when we say we will and being polite about it shouldn't be rare, but we know it can be. I'll pass this along to the crew.

author: Michael Colella
reply: Michael, we'll take happy wife, happy life as the highest rating there is. Thanks for having us out.

author: Larry Brewer
reply: Larry, weekly while they're active is how the year-round program is meant to run - we keep the pressure on until the yard goes quiet. Glad the catches are adding up. Thanks for the recommendation.
